description: Resource schema for an Amazon ECS daemon revision. A daemon revision is an immutable snapshot of a daemon's configuration at the time a daemon deployment was initiated. It captures the daemon task definition, container images, tag propagation, ECS managed tags, and execute command settings. Amazon ECS automatically creates a daemon revision whenever you create or update a daemon. This is a read-only resource that provides visibility into the daemon revisions of an Amazon ECS daemon.

ContainerImage.description: The details about the container image a daemon revision uses.

DaemonRevisionArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the daemon revision.

Cluster.description: The short name of the cluster that hosts the daemon (the cluster segment of the daemon revision ARN).

DaemonName.description: The name of the daemon (the daemon segment of the daemon revision ARN).

DaemonRevisionId.description: The ID of the daemon revision (the revision segment of the daemon revision ARN).

ClusterArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the cluster that hosts the daemon.

DaemonArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the daemon for this revision.

DaemonTaskDefinitionArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the daemon task definition used by this revision.

ContainerImages.description: The container images used by the daemon revision.

PropagateTags.description: Specifies whether tags are propagated from the daemon to the daemon tasks.

EnableECSManagedTags.description: Specifies whether Amazon ECS managed tags are turned on for the daemon tasks.

EnableExecuteCommand.description: Specifies whether the execute command functionality is turned on for the daemon tasks.

CreatedAt.description: The time that the daemon revision was created.
